item_name: Plan of Care Not Updated as Required
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The protocol item states a review/update frequency for the plan of care (upon a change of condition or at least every 6 months) but does not state an assessor observation/look-back window in days ending on an assessment reference date. The only look-back window stated anywhere in the document is the 7-day PRI look-back in Area 30 (p. 18), which pertains to the Patient Review Instrument, not to Area 10.

federal_coding_rules.rule: The clinical record must document that the plan of care is reviewed by a registered nurse upon a change of condition or at least every 6 months.

source.quote: The clinical record must document the plan of care is reviewed by a registered nurse upon a change of condition or at least every 6 months.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the plan of care is not updated as required, the claim will be disallowed.

source.quote: If the plan of care is not updated as required, the claim will be disallowed.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Scope/date applicability: this protocol applies to service dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025.
Time-period-specific regulatory basis applies: for services 05/25/18 and after, 18 NYCRR § 494.4(c); for services 03/17/93 through 05/24/18, 18 NYCRR § 494.4(b).

federal.criterion: The clinical record must contain documentation that a registered nurse reviewed the plan of care upon a change of condition or at least every 6 months.

source.quote: The clinical record must document the plan of care is reviewed by a registered nurse upon a change of condition or at least every 6 months.

federal.notes: Framed by the protocol as a mandatory record requirement whose absence results in claim disallowance.

federal.criterion: OMIG will review and consider any relevant contemporaneous documentation maintained and available in the provider's records to substantiate a claim.

source.quote: OMIG will review and consider any relevant contemporaneous documentation maintained and available in the provider’s records to substantiate a claim.

federal.notes: General documentation principle stated in the protocol's introduction; applies across audit areas.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The document does not tie Area 10 (Plan of Care Not Updated as Required) to any payment/case-mix classification. Case-mix-related content (RUGS Group Code, rate code) appears in Areas 12 and 13, not in Area 10.
